title: Yumimi Mix Remix
native_title: ゆみみみっくす リみっくす
overview:
Yumimi Yoshizawa is an ordinary high school girl who enjoys an easygoing life with her childhood friends Sakurako and Shinichi. Then one morning on the way to school she spots something strange in front of her, and from that day on, one bizarre and extraordinary event after another starts happening to Yumimi and her friends.

Yumimi Mix Remix is an interactive comic told through fully animated, brightly colored manga-style scenes. Choose commands as the story unfolds and your choices send it down different branches toward multiple endings.

- The complete Mega-CD adventure, with added animation scenes
- Bonus puzzle game, Yumimi Puzzle, that unlocks extra artwork
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
